items.text: A former teacher and Baldwin Park school board member, Blanca Rubio has represented the 48th Assembly District since 2016. She chairs the Assembly Governmental Organization Committee and the Select Committee on Domestic Violence. Her legislative work focuses on domestic violence, foster youth and school support for young students.

sentences.text: A former teacher and Baldwin Park school board member, Blanca Rubio has represented the 48th Assembly District since 2016.
She chairs the Assembly Governmental Organization Committee and the Select Committee on Domestic Violence.
Her legislative work focuses on domestic violence, foster youth and school support for young students.

items.text: She co-sponsored SB 273 to extend the statute of limitations for victims of domestic violence in certain cases. She authored AB 3129, a lifetime firearm restriction for domestic violence misdemeanors. She wrote AB 752 to prevent children from being unnecessarily expelled from state preschools. She co-authored a child literacy bill (AB 1454). Her campaign says she secured over $70 million for San Gabriel Valley road and park projects.
